caption:
Fig.1: A counterexample from robustness verification of a YOLOv3 model on a runway
detection task. Left: original image; right: perturbed image. Green boxes: ground truth,
blue box: original model prediction (IoU = 0.89), red box: prediction on the perturbed
image (IoU = 0.11).
delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed both original/perturbed runway panels and colored boxes. Ground-truth, original-prediction and perturbed-prediction mappings and IoUs 0.89/0.11 match the source caption. Title and legend add no measurement; underlying examples and all box coordinates remain exact.
